statBlock.name: Bone Devil (Polearm Variant)
statBlock.description: This bone devil hooks enemies with a long bone polearm before striking with its tail.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not hinder the devil’s darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The devil has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Hooked Polearm attack and one Sting attack.
Hooked Polearm. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit becomes Grappled (escape DC 14). The devil cannot use this polearm on another target until that grapple ends.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Sting. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 17 (5d6) poison damage. The target makes a DC 14 Constitution save or becomes Poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each turn and ends the condition on a success.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 71, including the Bone Devil Polearm sidebar. Resistance wording follows the official errata.
sections.Variant rules: Use the polearm Multiattack for this variant. The listed Claw remains available as a single attack.

statBlock.name: Bone Devil (Summoner Variant)
statBlock.description: This bone devil can call in infernal reinforcements.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not hinder the devil’s darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The devil has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Sting attack.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Sting. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 17 (5d6) poison damage. The target makes a DC 14 Constitution save or becomes Poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each turn and ends the condition on a success.
Summon Devil (1/day). Choose 2d6 Spined Devils or one Bone Devil, then roll a 40% chance to summon the chosen reinforcements magically. Each appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the summoner, acts as its ally, and cannot summon other devils. Each stays for up to 1 minute and vanishes early if it dies, its summoner dies, or the summoner spends an action to dismiss it.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 70–71, including the Devil Summoning sidebar. Resistance wording follows the official errata.
sections.Variant rules: Add Summon Devil to the base bone devil’s actions.

statBlock.name: Night Hag (Coven Variant)
statBlock.description: An exiled Feywild hag who sends nightmares to corrupt mortals and collect their souls. This hag belongs to a three-member coven.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The hag has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). No material components.
At will: Detect Magic, Magic Missile.
2/day each: Plane Shift (self only), Ray of Enfeeblement, Sleep.
sections.Actions:
Claws (hag form only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Change Shape. The hag magically becomes a Small or Medium female humanoid or resumes her true form. Her statistics stay the same and her equipment keeps its original form. She returns to her true form when she dies.
Etherealness. While carrying a Heartstone, the hag can magically cross between the Material and Ethereal Planes.
Nightmare Haunting (1/day). From the Ethereal Plane, the hag magically touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane. Protection from Evil and Good or Magic Circle blocks the touch. The target suffers visions while contact continues. If the visions last at least 1 hour, the target gains no benefit from that rest and its maximum HP decreases by 5 (1d10). Greater Restoration or similar magic ends the reduction. If its maximum HP reaches 0 this way, the target dies, and if it was evil, its soul is caught in the hag’s Soul Bag.
sections.Night hag items:
Heartstone. Carrying this very rare stone lets the hag use Etherealness. Its touch also cures any disease. The hag takes 30 days to make one.
Soul Bag. This very rare item holds one evil soul at a time. Only the hag who made it can use it to catch a soul with Nightmare Haunting. Making one takes 7 days and a humanoid sacrifice.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 176, 178–179. The coven sidebar is on p. 176. The official errata corrects innate spellcasting, Claws, and resistance wording.
sections.Variant rules: Night Hag (Coven) is the other library label for this printed coven profile.
sections.Shared spellcasting:
A coven has three hags of any type. All three can use these wizard spells while they are within 30 ft. of one another. Track one pool of spell slots for the whole coven. Each hag casts as a 12th-level spellcaster using Intelligence. This hag uses spell save DC 15 and +7 to hit with spell attacks for this list.
1st level (4 slots): Identify, Ray of Sickness.
2nd level (3 slots): Hold Person, Locate Object.
3rd level (3 slots): Bestow Curse, Counterspell, Lightning Bolt.
4th level (3 slots): Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph.
5th level (2 slots): Contact Other Plane, Scrying.
6th level (1 slot): Eyebite.
sections.Hag Eye: A coven can have one Hag Eye. A coven member on the same plane can spend an action to see through it. The eye has AC 10, 1 HP, and darkvision 60 ft. If it is destroyed, each coven member takes 3d10 psychic damage and becomes Blinded for 24 hours. All three hags must perform a 1-hour ritual to make a new eye. They cannot do so while Blinded, and an action outside the ritual makes them start over.

statBlock.name: Sea Hag (Coven Variant)
statBlock.description: A hag of polluted waters whose true face terrifies humanoids. She uses illusions to pass for another creature. This hag belongs to a three-member coven.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The hag breathes air and water.
Horrific Appearance. A humanoid that starts its turn within 30 ft. and sees the hag’s true form makes a DC 11 Wisdom save or becomes Frightened for 1 minute. It can save again at the end of each turn, with disadvantage if the hag is in its line of sight. A success ends the condition. Once the creature saves or the effect ends for it, it is immune to this hag’s Horrific Appearance for 24 hours. The creature can avert its eyes to skip the initial save unless it is Surprised or the hag reveals her true form suddenly. A creature that averts its eyes has disadvantage on attack rolls against her until the start of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Death Glare. Choose a Frightened creature within 30 ft. that the hag can see. If it can see her, it must make a DC 11 Wisdom save against the magic or drop to 0 HP.
Illusory Appearance. The hag magically disguises herself and her equipment as an ugly creature of her general size and humanoid shape. She can dismiss the effect as a bonus action, and it ends when she dies. Physical contact reveals discrepancies. Otherwise, spotting the illusion takes an action to inspect it and a successful DC 16 Intelligence (Investigation) check.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 176, 179. The coven sidebar is on p. 176.
